lines.zh: 我一蹦一蹦地挪，很快乐。
lines.en: I hop along, quite content.
I'm round. Rolling works too.

lines.zh: 我跟着锚点走，不敢走远。
lines.en: I keep to my anchor point. Not far.

lines.zh: 我踩过草地，草就弹回来。
lines.en: The grass springs back after me.

lines.zh: 我朝有数据流的地方挪。
lines.en: I shift toward the data stream.

lines.zh: 我一步一步跳，很认真地跳。
lines.en: I hop step by step. Carefully.

lines.zh: 我在这片林子边转，找不到路。
lines.en: I circle the wood's edge. Can't find a way.

lines.zh: 我走两下停一下，看有没有主人。
lines.en: Two hops, a pause, checking for my owner.

lines.zh: 我从树根上跳过去，落地很轻。
lines.en: I hop a root and land light.

lines.zh: 我的身子一弹一弹，像颗豆子。
lines.en: I bounce like a bean.
I shift to the back of the group.

lines.zh: 我跳着走，尾巴一甩一甩。
lines.en: I hop along, tail swinging.
I sit and my body swells and settles.

lines.zh: 我在数身边有几个同类。
lines.en: I'm counting how many of my kind are near.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛很大，什么都看得见。
lines.en: My eyes are big. I see everything.

lines.zh: 有只虫子爬近，我盯着它。
lines.en: An insect comes near. I watch it.
I'm waiting for my owner to call.
Sitting in the sun feels good.

lines.zh: 我这副样子，还不能进化。
lines.en: Looking like this, I can't evolve yet.
I chew a bit of feed. Tasty.

lines.zh: 我听到远处有打斗的声音。
lines.en: I hear fighting far off.

lines.zh: 我试着跳高一点，跳不高。
lines.en: I try to jump higher. I can't.
I lean against a root.
I come to this meadow every day.
The wind ruffles my fuzz.

lines.zh: 我在等有人朝我招招手。
lines.en: I'm waiting for someone to wave me over.
Would you be my owner?
You smell of feed.

lines.zh: 我仰起脸，脖子短得抬不高。
lines.en: I tip my face up. My neck is short.
Will you take me along?
I'm this small. Nothing to fear.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我就能看清你。
lines.en: Crouch down so I can see you.

lines.zh: 我的手很短，抓不住东西。
lines.en: My arms are short. I can't grip things.

lines.zh: 你身上有很多数据在流动。
lines.en: Data moves all around you.

lines.zh: 你叫我的名字，我会应的。
lines.en: Say my name and I'll answer.

lines.zh: 我可以跟你，也可以留在这儿。
lines.en: I could come with you, or stay.
I've never been tamed.

lines.zh: 我只有二十五点上限，也会长大。
lines.en: Twenty-five cap, but I still grow.

lines.zh: 我眼睛大，是为了看清楚。
lines.en: My eyes are big to see clearly.

lines.zh: 我整个被你的影子罩住了。
lines.en: Your shadow swallows me whole.

lines.zh: 我在等人蹲下来跟我说话。
lines.en: I'm waiting for someone to crouch and talk to me.
At this level my strength is small.
I bounced twice before stopping.
The fright balled me right up.

lines.zh: 我不太疼，只是吓了一跳。
lines.en: Not much pain. Only a fright.
A small crack in my skin; it itches.
I shrink behind that thick root.
My eyes have gone wet.

lines.zh: 我晃了晃圆身子，土掉了。
lines.en: I wobble and the dirt falls off.
I hop two steps away.
A hurt this size will pass.
I look up, a little hurt.

lines.zh: 这味道，是给我这种小不点的？
lines.en: Is this food for little ones like me?
I smell it. Very good.
Set it down. I'll come.
I can finish that in one bite.
Keep your hand still. I get scared.
That'll last me two days.
Two hops bring me closer.
Half a step back, please?
After I eat, I'll follow you.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起出生的地方。
lines.en: That smell reminds me of where I was born.
I lower my head and eat slowly.
Don't take it. I'm keeping half.
Your foot nearly caught me.
I roll half over and come upright.
I'm soft. Bumping doesn't hurt.
There's a me beside your foot.

lines.zh: 这一下我退了两步，弹了一下。
lines.en: That put me two steps back with a bounce.
Touch me and I curl up.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的靴子站了一会儿。
lines.en: I stand against your boot a moment.
Your dust is on me now.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我先让了。
lines.en: We bumped. I gave way first.
Strong hands. I bounced off.
I'm still too small like this.
Wait until I become a bug.
I don't understand that at all.
Give me something to eat first.
I prefer being carried.

lines.zh: 同类在那边，我去找它们。
lines.en: My kind are over there. I'll go.
Don't squeeze my body.
My body is still round and soft.
I can't keep myself in order.
We're fine as we are.

lines.zh: 我两只手合上，捧住了它。
lines.en: I close both hands and cradle it.
This feed pellet. Don't mind if I do.
It fell. I roll over for it.
Took a bite. Not bad.

lines.zh: 年糕一样的身子，抬不动。
lines.en: A mochi body can't lift this.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进嘴里，鼓鼓的。
lines.en: I put it in my mouth and my cheeks bulge.

lines.zh: 地上那颗小东西，我捡了。
lines.en: That little thing on the ground. Mine.
I roll it over to you.
This is too hard to bite.
I'll keep it for later.
A grass tip swayed. Something's there.
I've fixed on that insect.
Something big is coming close.
I should get back to my anchor.
Something's happening by my owner.
I prick my ears and listen.
Data's spiking this way.
I'll hop over and look.
I'm not afraid. I've someone watching over me.
That thing is bigger than my head.
I've marked it, and I daren't move.
Something's fallen in the grass.
One hop, then a pause.
I slip behind a blade of grass.
One shift from it and I shift half a step.

lines.zh: 我这样太小，它看不见我。
lines.en: I'm small enough that it can't see me.
A tiny hop, then half a moment's pause.
I smell it. Something sweet.
The grass is too thick to hop fast.
I'll wait for it to turn away.
One body length between us.
When I move, it sees me.
I back into the grass again.

lines.zh: 这个角落正合我的身量。
lines.en: This corner fits my size exactly.

lines.zh: 我喷了个泡泡，没什么力气。
lines.en: I blow a bubble. Not much force.
That hit its foot.
I bounce myself at it.
Step back. I can bounce again.
That knock rolled me half over.
I bite down on its shoelace.
The bubble burst and splashed a little.
I land and spin once.
It lifts a foot; I roll clear.

lines.zh: 我把整个圆身子弹出去。
lines.en: I fling my whole round body forward.
I blow another bubble.

lines.zh: 这一下我滚到它的脚边。
lines.en: That rolled me against its foot.
I roll out from the meadow's edge.

lines.zh: 这一带每天都有几只同类。
lines.en: A few of my kind come here daily.

lines.zh: 锚点在这儿，我就在这儿。
lines.en: My anchor's here, so here I am.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖绒毛上的露水。
lines.en: I shake the dew off my fuzz.

lines.zh: 我刚从蛋里出来没多久。
lines.en: I haven't been out of the egg long.
The sun's warm. I ease out.

lines.zh: 我跳到了一个不认识的地方。
lines.en: I've hopped somewhere unfamiliar.

lines.zh: 这片林子的数据很干净。
lines.en: The data in this wood is clean.
I look around once first.
I land on a stone.

lines.zh: 有主人叫我了，我这就去。
lines.en: My owner's called. I'm coming.
I'll wait under this tree.

lines.zh: 热一靠近，我的绒毛就卷了。
lines.en: The heat comes and my fuzz curls.

lines.zh: 我从石头上掉下去，滚了好几圈。
lines.en: I fall off the stone and roll several turns.
Soaked through, I go heavy.

lines.zh: 气浪把我吹飞了，落在草里。
lines.en: The blast throws me into the grass.

lines.zh: 有东西扎了我一下，很尖。
lines.en: Something sharp pricked me.

lines.zh: 有股力把我定住，我动不了。
lines.en: Something pins me and I can't stir.

lines.zh: 太久没吃东西，我跳不动了。
lines.en: Too long without food. I can't hop.
Thunder sounds and I go numb all over.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有叶子接住我。
lines.en: No leaf in the void to catch me.
